appeared as an empty property.[/p][p]→ This issue may still appear when continuing from already affected save files, but does not occur in save files created after the September 11 hotfix.[/p][p]→ If the issue persists in an existing save file, it can be resolved by using the “Move Zoi Between Families” feature in Edit City > All Families List.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some Zois would stand still without fulfilling any needs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where completed urges were not removed from the UI when fulfilled by a Zoi that is not currently being played.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Travel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an intermittent issue where lights may intermittently flicker on streets or properties.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Zois would refuse to engage in conversations or certain interactions may not function as intended when using mods that modify specific data.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Build Mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where auto-scrolling in Build Mode made it difficult to select furniture.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the floor in the hallway of Adam Entertainment was not visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the turtle figure object could not be placed on small or medium display shelves.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Canvas[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where no error popup was shown when uploading a preset with file path errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where downloads would not start after launching the game when scheduling a download via the web Canvas.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]※ [b]For game stability, all mods will be automatically disabled when updates or patches are applied. [/b]You can reactivate them afterwards, so please keep this in mind.[/p][p]※ You can check the issues we’re currently investigating on the [url="https://forum.playinzoi.com/t/september-known-issues/4554"][u]Known Issues page[/u][/url].  [/p][p]If you encounter any problems while playing, please report them anytime via the [url="https://forum.playinzoi.com/"][u]inZOI Forums[/u][/url].[/p][p]As always, you can also share issues through the following channels:[/p][list][*][p][url="http://support.playinzoi.com/"][u]inZOI Support Page[/u][/url] / [url="https://discord.com/invite/inzoi"][u]Official Discord[/u][/url] / [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2456740/discussions/"][u]Steam Discussions[/u][/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ll continue working to make inZOI more stable and enjoyable for everyone.[/p][p]Thank you, as always, for your continued support and valuable feedback.
[/p][p]The inZOI Team[/p]

notes.title: Light Up Cahaya Event!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140680/be770511b59643dcb9c35039407249349fe2e127.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello Creators,[/p][p] [/p][p]The City of Light — [b]Cahaya[/b] — has been updated![/p][p]Cahaya is a new DLC region in inZOI, themed as a sunlit, exotic resort destination — its name literally means [i]“light.”
[/i]We want to hear your thoughts on what features, ideas, or improvements could be added to Cahaya![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]✅ How to Participate[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Head over to the new [b]\[Light Up Cahaya][/b] category on the inZOI forum and share your feedback![/p][list][*][p]Log in to the [url="https://forum.playinzoi.com/"]inZOI Forums[/url] after signing up.[/p][/*][*][p]Go to the newly created [b][url="https://forum.playinzoi.com/c/light-up-cahaya/11"]\[Light Up Cahaya][/url][/b] category.[/p][/*][*][p]Post your feedback or ideas about the new region, Cahaya, following the format below:[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Share any suggestions, feedback, or improvement ideas related to Cahaya.[/p][/*][*][p]Feel free to use any format — texts or images[/p][/*][*][p]Please write [b]at least 2–3 lines[/b] and include specific, constructive feedback or ideas.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🗓️ Event Period[/b][/h3][list][*][p]August 20, 2025 (Wed) – September 16, 2025 (Tue), 2:59 PM (UTC)[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🏆 Winner Announcement[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Winners will be announced via a forum notice on [b]September 25, 2025 (Thu) [/b]and will also be contacted [b]individually via email[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎁 Event Rewards (15 Winners)[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A total of 15 participants who post in the [b][url="https://forum.playinzoi.com/c/light-up-cahaya/11"]\[Light Up Cahaya][/url][/b] category during the event period will be selected to receive the [b]Official inZOI Kit[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Official inZOI Kit[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140680/8e92b5a98594dc33975f09a4e8d50aa07121fe2b.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]📍 Important Notes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Each participant may participate in the event only once. Duplicate or repetitive submissions with the same content will be disqualified, and posts may be removed or merged after the event ends.[/p][/*][*][p]Only posts written in English and submitted to the event-specific category will be considered as valid entries.[/p][/*][*][p]Posts that are irrelevant to the purpose of the event or that violate forum policies may be deleted or result in sanctions without prior notice.[/p][/*][*][p]Posts unrelated to Cahaya or focused solely on general gameplay feedback will be excluded from the event and may be moved to the \[Wishlist] category.[/p][/*][*][p]Entries may be disqualified or canceled under the following circumstances:[/p][list][*][p]If the participant deletes their forum account or event post[/p][/*][*][p]If the participant enters using another person’s account[/p][list][*][p]In such cases, the participant may not only be disqualified but also be permanently banned from the forum and excluded from future events.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]If the participant violates the Terms of Use or Forum Guidelines.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Privacy Notice:[/b] Based on your request to participate in the Event, we will process your KRAFTON ID(email address) and service usage history. If you win, we may contact you via your KRAFTON ID(email address) to provide information on the follow-up procedures.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Privacy Notice:[/b] We need to collect certain information from you to verify your information, deliver the prize, and offer related customer support services. notes.title: Inzoi update takes the life sim on vacation, and finally lets your Zois have fun
notes.content:
The first free Inzoi DLC is here, whisking us away to its new Island Getaway, Cahaya. The resort location transforms the realistic Sims rival into an experience free of traditional life sims, creating something more akin to Stardew Valley where you'll farm, mine gemstones, fish, and snorkel. You can start a new life there or take a vacation, but the new map is far from the only reason to check in with the life game. Nexon's Inzoi Studio has also given Zois a much-needed emotional makeover, and there are fresh character and build options, along with a ramp-up of some of the simulation aspects.

[/p][h2][b]■ Interactions: Zois With Emotions and Personality[/b][/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeb-_iBTTEdk4J20TKYiPdtYXYElx1KkuBqQcg2hzk9MgWoD-MXIWfOvhvyVyZxVE8QOXAguPf0HYfiGgzF7DZb75Qj_FqtMakRuheYDWW6c1ch2qQDHmIBMOacA1Uv4OS_PmAE?key=T9OspXQ1GnBx2NUaEg8Jzg"][/img] [/p][p]Zois now express emotions more naturally and interact more fluidly, forming deeper and more dynamic relationships. notes.title: High Priority Issues in the August 20 Update
notes.content: [p]Hello, Creators.[/p][p][/p][p]The Island Getaway DLC will be released on August 20, bringing new content and features to the game.[/p][p]Prior to its release, we would like to share a few high-priority issues that have been identified in this update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]1. Translation Quality Issues[/b][/p][p]Due to the overwhelming amount of content added during this update, we experienced some difficulty keeping translation quality consistent across all languages.[/p][p]Our team is working to improve localization quality across all languages and will continue to make updates for better term consistency, coherence, and UI readability.[/p][p]To check the localization progress for each language, go to \[Settings > Gameplay].[/p][p][/p][p][b]2. Limitations on Accessing New Features[/b][/p][p]Due to compatibility issues, some new features and content will be unavailable on preexisting save files. This includes features related to city expansions and updated systems, which can only be properly accessed on new save files.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and will take measures to make the game more backward compatible with updates going forward.[/p][p][/p][p][b]3. Mac Version Issues[/b][/p][p]Some features in the Windows version may not be fully supported on Mac systems at the time of the update's release.[/p][p]To address these issues, we will be implementing hotfixes after the update to make sure players can experience the game at the same quality on all platforms.[/p][p]Our team remains committed to listening to your feedback and working to deliver a better game experience through updates and improvements.[/p][p]Feel free to share any issues or feedback with us through the [u][url="http://forum.playinzoi.com/"]inZOI Forums[/url][/u] or our [u][url="https://support.playinzoi.com/hc/ko/requests/new?null"]customer support page[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you,[/p][p]The inZOI Team[/p]

notes.title: Kjun's Letter: Addressing Player Feedback and Launching the Brainstorm Channel
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Creators. [/p][p]Kjun here.[/p][p]
[/p][p]The weather here in Korea has been extremely hot these past few days. With temperatures nearing 40°C, our team is spending more time indoors to work on inZOI. How's summer where you all are?[/p][p]
[/p][p]Today, I'd like to start things off by talking about the Cahaya update.[/p][p]Many players expressed their excitement and expectations for the update after it was revealed. Seeing so much enthusiasm for something we've been working hard on developing has been both encouraging and a reminder of our responsibility toward our community.[/p][p]While Cahaya remains the central focus of the August update, we'll also be making improvements to the game's simulations in response to player feedback. Here are two key areas we're focusing on.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]1. Unique Zoi Personalities and Behavior[/b][/p][p]We've received feedback from many players regarding the lack of distinctive behavior and traits among different Zois. To address this, we're adding various improvements to make each Zoi's unique personality and preferences feel more pronounced.[/p][p][b]2. Zoi Goals and Player Guides[/b][/p][p] Several players have expressed difficulty finding out what to do next in the game, largely because key information related to Zoi goals is hidden deep within the UI. We've also received feedback that the lack of meaningful rewards makes fulfilling these goals feel underwhelming. While inZOI is designed to encourage a wide variety of playstyles, we are working on making the core gameplay loop more clear and engaging.[/p][p]
[/p][p]I'd also like to share some details on Cahaya's overall concept and gameplay, which many players have been curious about.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Cahaya is themed as an island getaway. To bring that experience to life, players will be able to make brief trips to this region while living in either Dowon or Bliss Bay. We've all had moments where we want to escape the monotony of everyday life. Cahaya was designed to offer such an escape, a peaceful holiday retreat where players can unwind and relax.[/p][p]This update will also introduce swimming, a key part of any vacation experience. We hope this addition makes your time in Cahaya feel even more immersive and relaxing.[/p][p]
[/p][p]We're aware that both adding new content and refining existing gameplay are equally important, which is why our team is working harder than ever. While we can't fix everything overnight, we remain committed to making steady improvements to provide our Creators with the experience they desire.[/p][p]
[/p][p]To hear from our players more directly, we've also launched the [b][u][url="https://discord.com/channels/1162040845181124618/1387652526156808283"]Brainstorm channel[/url][/u][/b] in our Discord.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Unlike the Kjun's Letter format, which was somewhat one-sided in its approach, the Brainstorm channel will allow for more interactive communication surrounding the game's development. We hope this helps us improve the game based on your feedback.[/p][p]Kjun's Letters will no longer follow a regular release schedule going forward and will instead be posted whenever our team has information to communicate with you all. However, feel free to share your thoughts and suggestions with us any time in the Brainstorm channel.[/p][p]It's very hot out there these days, so be sure to take care.[/p][p]I'll be back soon with more updates for you all![/p][p]
[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]Kjun[/p]

notes.title: Kjun's Letter: Meet the Team at the inZOI MeetUp!
notes.content: [p]Hello, Creators.[/p][p][/p][p]Kjun here.[/p][p][/p][p]Here in Korea, the monsoon season has just begun, and it's been raining almost every day. How's the weather where you are? I imagine summer is in full swing for some of you as well. On our end, we're busy preparing for gamescom this August, while also pouring our excitement into development for Cahaya.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition to working on the build for gamescom, we've been preparing several events. One event that we're especially excited to announce is the inZOI MeetUp, which will offer Creators a chance to meet and communicate with the inZOI Team in person.[/p][p][/p][p]Over the past two years, our community has shown incredible support for inZOI. This event is dedicated to honoring that support, bringing our team and the community together to reflect on the past, present, and future of inZOI. We hope it becomes a special experience for everyone involved, and we can't wait to see you there.[/p][p][/p][p]Registration for the MeetUp will begin on July 4, which happens to be the day this post goes live. While we unfortunately won't be able to invite everyone, we hope to see as many Creators as possible join us for this special occasion.[/p][p][/p][p]This event was planned for two main reasons. First, we wanted to personally thank the many Creators who have supported inZOI through our journey so far. Second, now that it's been about 90 days since inZOI's early access release, I've had some time to look back upon whether I had truly understood what our players wanted. Recent conversations with Partner Creators, along with feedback from the broader community, allowed our team to reflect on areas we might have overlooked. At the upcoming MeetUp, we hope to hear similar feedback firsthand to help shape the direction of the game's development and updates going forward.[/p][p][/p][p]Please keep letting us know what you think. Your feedback helps shape the future of inZOI and is always appreciated.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for your continued passion and support.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]- Kjun[/p]

notes.title: Kjun's Letter: A Sneak Peek at Cahaya
notes.content: [p]Hello, Creators.[/p][p][/p][p]Kjun here.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you're enjoying inZOI following the June update. We're aware that there's still plenty of room for improvement, which is why we're working hard to deliver a better experience for our players.[/p][p][/p][p]Our team is hard at work preparing the next wave of content for the August update. We're especially excited for this update because it will be introducing a third city to the game.[/p][p][/p][p]On that note, we'd like to announce some changes. The third city, formerly announced as Kucingku, has now been changed to Cahaya, a resort-themed destination where players can enjoy some rest and relaxation away from the bustle of city life. The word "Cahaya" means "light", and true to its name, the city offers a variety of vibrant and refreshing experiences across exotic islands that can't be found in previous cities, such as farming, relaxing, boating, and exploring uninhabited islands. We're working hard to make this update truly worth the wait.[/p][p][/p][p]Cahaya is a city themed around "rest". While developing inZOI has been a source of great joy for me, there are times when I feel the urge to get away from it all. Inspired by these feelings, I wanted to create a retreat for players exhausted by the motions of everyday life to unwind in.[/p][p][/p][p]There is one thing that we were unable to address in this update. We've received a great deal of feedback from players asking for improvements to the job system, but because Cahaya was designed as a resort-themed city, features like jobs and schools didn't quite feel like the right fit. As such, we've made the decision to exclude them from this city entirely. Players instead can enjoy a self-sufficient lifestyle through activities such as farming or fishing. Improvements to the job system will be coming with the next city update.[/p][p][/p][p]In response to player feedback, we are also making improvements to make emotional expressions seem more natural, improve the relationship system, and add depth to interactions.[/p][p][/p][p]We recently shared these details during a video call with our Partner Creators, who gave us a lot of valuable feedback. If you have any thoughts of your own, please don't hesitate to share them with us. I truly enjoy hearing from the community, and I'm always paying close attention to what our players have to say. Your feedback helps shape the future of inZOI.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, inZOI will be heading to Germany once again to participate in this year's gamescom, where the August update and Cahaya Free DLC will be officially revealed. Until then, we hope you continue to enjoy a wonderful time with inZOI.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope this coming summer brings you nothing but joy and lasting memories. As always, thank you again for your continued support.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]- Kjun[/p]

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfMCzdD3mlmGwO8XgajrapMfcuLxBGefKaB2SK14XqMmWhZ0L7-7k8_xxJNMRJ1IQ-JsJAm0WvVwKDS-3I6Sg-4ynSDZJpAAEo8FWN9Syjok351qKOmGKVN_DUicQ7XryFlltqI?key=iOVBTn6b04asG6qJqW62-A"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where student-aged NPCs were being generated infinitely.[/p][list][*][p]Please note that this fix applies only to newly started games via “New Game”.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a crash could occur intermittently when moving lots after ending a schedule.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where changes to the class value in the Browse Mods tab were not applied immediately.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ll continue working to make inZOI more stable and enjoyable for everyone.[/p][p]Thank you, as always, for your continued support and valuable feedback.[/p][p]
[/p][p]The inZOI Team[/p]

notes.title: [v0.2.0] Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p][b]◆ Details[/b][/p][p]◽️ [b]Patch Date:[/b] June 13th, 2025[/p][p]◽️ [b]Game Version:[/b] 20250612.4545.W [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][previewyoutube="nuiFqAR7ucI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]This update introduces the inZOI ModKit, along with over 200 new items, greatly expanding customization options.[/i]
[/p][p][i]Zois can explore a wider range of relationship dynamics with new features like adoption, non-marital childbirth, teen romance, and the ability to send the first text. Gender identity settings have also become more flexible. This update also features more realistic simulations, as well as changes that include extended young adulthood, reworks to starting funds, and improvements to the prison system. General improvements to quality of life have been made as well, with features like UI size settings, new cheat codes, and improved controls.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]For more details, check the patch notes below![/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ ModKit[/b][/h2][p]This update formally introduces the ModKit, allowing players to create and manage mods in inZOI. With this feature, Creators can now design custom outfits and furniture, and share them with the community. For more details on creating and using mods, visit the official website.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://playinzoi.com/guide/mod"]https://playinzoi.com/guide/mod[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]◽️ inZOI Mod Browser[/b][/p][p]　- The Mod Browser has been added to allow easier access to mods in-game. Players can manage mods using the Browser's search, install, delete, and other features.[/p][p][b]◽️ Wizard-Based Modding Features[/b][/p][p]　- A wizard-style UI has been added to streamline the mod creation process without the need for complex settings. Use this intuitive interface to create mods and access certain content (set outfits, objects, etc.) immediately. This feature supports the creation of set outfits as standalone items for character customization, as well as placeable in-game items like furniture and decorative objects.[/p][p][b]◽️ Editing Data[/b][/p][p]　- Players can edit game data to add custom rules or features, including new prices, placement rules, and interactions.[/p][p][b]◽️ Sharing and Distribution[/b][/p][p]　- Once created, mods can be shared with other players through CurseForge or extracted directly and added to the game manually.[/p][p][b]◽️ Content and Sample Resources[/b][/p][p]Content and Sample Resources[/p][p]　- Basic resources required to create mods will be provided. The Unreal assets included are based on actual in-game assets, making it easier for beginners to understand their structure. These assets can also be duplicated and used within the wizard tool.[/p][p]　- FBX files will be provided to allow assets to be edited with third-party tools. Sample mods will also be included to make the structure of these assets easier to understand. These samples cover features ranging from Create a Zoi (CAZ) and building to editing data.[/p][p][b]◽️ DCC Plugins[/b][/p][p]　- Plugins for Maya and Blender are now supported. These come with tools and guidelines to help Creators make their own custom outfits for inZOI.[/p][p][b]◽️ Comprehensive Guide[/b][/p][p]　- A comprehensive guide on using the ModKit will be provided, containing instructions and tips for using these tools, creating content, and distributing mods, all in one place.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]■ Character[/b][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfu_Y5WhQEilDIuQSWVVlU1N_w8cpXPvWxvXVux6h9W2VZ__fhfNNPAS3tf-5sjcSmi24SeAEEckhHEXcDCLDDxURVdP1AZO-QY3HFtiOYiIhH8r9g4ImVbH1mvvIqgbb_ib2dBgg?key=VI2VA5jQ76OwGCLV5PTGDw"][/img][/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfmjpP6q4DLGhWImrmdnfCnGtNmpLjySKehGdPDw59Kvc1Dy70I9KcMms9wroDe9g0u-VqqCwO0puFXYWObtcFr8S0X3poioiUrWnAMThffg-s8qT0eKD4cI-wzR2GQ_8yVS_Pp?key=VI2VA5jQ76OwGCLV5PTGDw"][/img][/p][p]Updates have been made to character items, expanding the variety of available hairstyles. Over 20 new outfits have also been added, including entirely new outfit types such as overalls and boots, offering even more options for customization.
[/p][p][b]◽️ 29 new items have been added.[/b][/p][p]　- Hair: 5 items[/p][p]　- Tops: 4 items[/p][p]　- Bottoms: 3 items[/p][p]　- Outerwear: 1 item[/p][p]　- Sets: 3 items[/p][p]　- Shoes: 3 items[/p][p]　- Socks and Stockings: 9 items[/p][p]　- Accessories: 1 item
[/p][p][b]Improvements have been made to certain features in the Character Studio, making them more precise. [/b]Previously, accessories like glasses, headpieces, and earrings could only be worn in fixed positions, sometimes causing them to overlap with other objects or be hidden. Now, you can freely adjust the size and position of these accessories, allowing for more detailed and flexible styling than ever before.[/p][p][/p][p][b]◽️ New Features[/b][/p][p]　- Edit Accessory Position: Allows free placement[/p][p]　- Authors for Zoi Presets will always be displayed[/p][p]　- Authors for My Textures downloaded from Canvas will be displayed in a tooltip[/p][p]　- Traits and Desired Lives can now be randomly selected when creating a Zoi[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ Building[/b][/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf96h7Z5kuKRw_wxoW9gkMwsEfdL1vjXKdH6CcJmyA6wioxLqG-OecB9bKUo7HO8OZQSkB9onhhZT1648NMELo9TUhgTarN-Cysf2IeOCoVhN1UubOCHQIz3vEWMr5iEl9bQ2I7?key=VI2VA5jQ76OwGCLV5PTGDw"][/img][/p][p][b]Updates have been made to expand furniture categories that were previously limited in options.[/b][/p][p]Practical additions that also allow for personal expression have been added, including single beds, kitchen furniture, various rugs and lighting, and baby and children's furniture.[/p][p]Unique items like barred windows and flashlights have also been added, making it easier to create themed settings and more visually diverse environments.
[/p][p][b]◽️ 175 new items added.[/b][/p][p]　- Bedroom: 14 items[/p][p]　- Living Room: 5 items[/p][p]　- Home Office: 4 items[/p][p]　- Kitchen: 52 items[/p][p]　- Bathroom: 2 item[/p][p]　- Common: 76 items[/p][p]　- Outdoors: 2 items[/p][p]　- Doors: 20 items
[/p][p]Updates and improvements to the building system have also been made to make building more convenient.[/p][p][/p][p][b]◽️ Building Shortcuts[/b][/p][p]　- Building shortcuts will make the building process faster and more conveniently.[/p][p]Supported shortcuts will include Delete Tool (K), Edit Color and Material (Ctrl + R), Put in Inventory (B), and Move House (H).[/p][p][b]◽️ Auto Save[/b][/p][p]　- A feature has been added that automatically loads unsaved changes while making edits in Build Mode as a property preset if the game shuts down unexpectedly.[/p][p][b]◽️ Improvements to Gizmo Usability[/b][/p][p]　- The position and shape of the roof gizmo have been adjusted to make editing eaves more intuitive.[/p][p][b]◽️ Improvements to Editing Roofing and Shadow-Casting Lighting[/b][/p][p]    - Lights can now be placed on ceilings and under rooms above the first floor.[/p][p]　- A new icon has been added in Build Mode that allows you to easily check settings for shadow-casting lighting.[/p][p][b]◽️ Quality-of-Life Improvements to Camera Modes[/b][/p][p]　- When switching from Free Camera to Top View/Shoulder View, the viewpoint will now be adjusted automatically to prevent walls or objects from obstructing the view.[/p][p]　- The camera now defaults to the nearest floor level if there are no ceilings near its position, and can center its movement around a selected object. Additionally, camera rotation has been improved to move more naturally around its axis.[/p][p][b]◽️ Improvements to Wall View[/b][/p][p]　- Wall-mounted objects (such as picture frames) will no longer remain visible when toggling between Wall View modes.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ Gameplay[/b][/h2][p][b]More Ways to Build Families and Relationships[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Zois can build families and express their emotions in more varied and flexible ways. Added features like adoption, non-marital childbirth, teen romance, and new text interactions make relationships richer and more realistic.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]New Features[/u][/b][/p][p]◽️[b] Adopt a Child[/b][/p][p]　- With this update, Zois can now welcome a child into their family without using the Make a Baby interaction through adoption. To use this feature, go to your computer or laptop to access the Adopt a Child menu. As long as they meet the age and property requirements, anybody can bring a new member into their family![/p][p][b]◽️ Create a Child with Medical Help[/b][/p][p]　- You can now use the Create a Child with Medical Help interaction on a computer or laptop to have a child with the help of science. The procedure costs 1,000 Mew, and the child will have your Zoi's genetic traits. You can also choose to partner up with another Zoi for this procedure, resulting in a child that reflects both Zois' traits.[/p][p][b]◽️ Non-Marital Birth[/b][/p][p]　- To promote even more diverse kinds of families, Zois can now give birth without getting married.[/p][p][b]◽️ Teenage Romance[/b][/p][p]　- Teenager Zois can now enter romantic relationships. Look forward to shy conversations, sweet first dates, and awkwardly adorable interactions. Random choice card events, like receiving an anonymous love confession, may also occur. After school, you might even get the chance to unmask your secret admirer![/p][p][b]◽️ Exchanging Gifts[/b][/p][p]　- Zois can now exchange items with each other. Depending on a Zoi's personality and preferences, the same gift may be received in different ways. A variety of new giftable items are available on Pocket Market, and you can even withdraw cash from an ATM to gift money directly.[/p][p][b]◽️ Visits from Other Zois[/b][/p][p]　- Other Zois in the city can now make the first move to meet your Zoi. They might make plans for a meetup via text, or even show up unannounced at your doorstep. Be it longing, insecurity, or a simple whim of the heart, their reasons for visiting may vary. Whether the meeting ends with a heartwarming moment or a bittersweet goodbye depends entirely on how your Zoi responds.[/p][p][b]◽️ Sending the First Text[/b][/p][p]　- You can now initiate a conversation by sending a text to any Zoi by using the Contacts app on your smartphone (P).[/p][p]Responses will vary depending on the relationship between the two Zois and the recipient's current emotional state. On a good day, you might get a friendly reply... but if the other Zoi is in a bad mood, expect the unexpected![/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Improved Features[/u][/b][/p][p][b]◽️ Romantic Relationships with Everyone![/b][/p][p]　- New settings have been added that allow Zois to express their gender identity and romantic attraction more freely. These settings can also now be adjusted at any time. Zois who align with your identity and romantic attraction will also appear in the overworld, setting the stage for potential relationships.[/p][p][b]◽️ Relationship-Appropriate Conversations[/b][/p][p]　- When player Zois reach a certain level in their relationship, their conversations will change to better reflect that dynamic. For example, if a relationship between two Zois progresses from Mutual Crush to Sweetheart, the tone of their dynamic will become positive, increasing the likelihood of positive conversations between them.[/p][p][b]◽️ UI Improvements Related to Romantic Relationships[/b][/p][p]　- In response to player feedback, the message "You're getting to know each other as romantic interests" will no longer appear. The romantic relationship gauge for Zois will now only be displayed in the Relationships menu after at least one romantic conversation has occurred.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Improvements and Updates to Simulations[/b][/p][p]Core systems that determine a Zoi's pace of life have been rebalanced. These include changes in body weight and physique, aging, starting funds, and prison systems. From play and parenting to interactions and NPC behavior, in-game simulations have been polished to feel more realistic and organic.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b][u]New Features[/u][/b][/p][p][b]◽️ Changes to Body Weight and Muscle Mass[/b][/p][p]　- Zois will now undergo changes in physique based on their lifestyle choices. Working out will cause Zois to build muscle, while overeating will cause them to gain weight. As their Fitness level increases, Zois become more resistant to aches and fatigue, allowing them to endure longer or more intense physical activity with ease.[/p][p][b]◽️ New Swing and Hula Hoop Interactions Added[/b][/p][p]　- Swings and hula hoops can be used by Zois who are Children or older. Interacting with these items will improve a Zoi's Fitness skill.[/p][p][b]◽️ Time Skip Feature for Rabbit Hole Interactions[/b][/p][p][b]◽️ 8 New Pocket Market Items Added [/b][/p][p]　- Four new item categories have been added to Pocket Market: Luxury, Practical, Charming, and Silly. Gifts purchased from Pocket Market can be given to or exchanged with other Zois.[/p][p][b]◽️ 5 New Donuts Added[/b][/p][p]　- The Poison Donut, Charming Donut, Flirty Donut, Diet Donut, and High-Calorie Donut have been added.
[/p][p][b][u]Improved Features[/u][/b][/p][p][b]◽️ Improvements to Prison System[/b][/p][p]　- Several changes have been made to simulate a more realistic prison experience. Vending machines have been removed, and meals are now only available during set meal times. Lifers will appear, casual conversations are prohibited, beds are less comfortable, and overall needs are more difficult to fulfill within prison.[/p][p][i]※ These changes will only be available after starting a new game.[/i][/p][p][b]◽️ Improvements to Starting and Move-In Funds[/b][/p][p]　- Adjustments have been made to help players start their journey as homeowners more easily while giving them a sense of progression. The furniture initially provided has also been rebalanced, setting the stage for a humble beginning while leaving room to grow.[/p][p]　- Welfare support can now only be claimed once. Families residing in the city are now able to find jobs and support themselves financially.[/p][p][i]※ These changes will only be available after starting a new game.[/i][/p][p][b]◽️ Improvements to Age Progression[/b][/p][p]　- In response to player feedback, Zois will now spend less time as Middle-Aged Zois, with the Young Adult stage being significantly extended. The time Zois spend as Infants, Teenagers, and all age groups in-between has also been extended, allowing players to enjoy more of their childhood and adolescence.[/p][p][b]◽️Improvements to Fixed Schedules[/b][/p][p]　- Schedules will no longer be auto-generated for player Zois.[/p][p][b]◽️ Improvements to Universal Text Notifications[/b][/p][p]　- Zois can now receive text advisories related to severe weather conditions, such as heat waves or extreme cold.[/p][p][b]◽️ Improvements to Interactions Related to Newborns and Children[/b][/p][p]　- New interactions such as Laugh, Cry, and Change Diaper have been added. Newborns can now gain emotion buffs or wake nearby Zois according to their needs.[/p][p][b]◽️ Improvements to Idle Family Options[/b][/p][p]　- Aging for idle families has been disabled by default. Players can toggle this setting manually. Additional improvements have been made to idle family narratives and maximum capacity.[/p][p][b]◽️Improvements to Basic Info Display[/b][/p][p]　- Hovering your cursor over a Zoi will now display their age group, marital status, and the number of days left until they reach their next age group.[/p][p][b]◽️ Age restrictions have been added for NPC pregnancies to prevent unintended pregnancies[/b][/p][p][b]◽️ Improvements to Object Interactions[/b][/p][p]　- New interactions have been added, including Write Entry in Plant Observation Journal and Shower While Humming. Features related to certain objects, such as yoga mats and pots, have also been improved for smoother interaction.[/p][p][b]◽️ Zois with Autonomy enabled will no longer remain idle without performing any actions[/b][/p][p][b]◽️ Improvements to Street Encounters[/b][/p][p]　- New interactions have been added that allow Zois to look at, greet, or react to objects and other Zois on the street. Systems for avoiding pedestrians and traffic, as well as proactive NPC reactions have also been implemented.[/p][p][b]◽️ Fixed an issue where relationships would reset immediately after marriage, triggering negative interactions[/b][/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where romantic relationships reset after marriage. A portion of the existing relationship now carries over into the family relationship score to better reflect the bond built before marriage.[/p][p][b]◽️ Fixed an issue where moving certain Zois into new homes caused their previous family relationships to reset[/b][/p][p][b]◽️ A system message will now appear when an object cannot be used.[/b][/p][p][b]◽️ When using the Read Book interaction at a bookshelf, Zois will now prioritize selecting nearby books that have been taken out of the shelf.[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Animations/Audio[/b][/p][p]Updates have been made to animations, enhancing immersion and making them feel more natural.[/p][p]Motions have been polished for better quality. Changes have been made to the position of microphones held by rappers, exaggerated emotional expressions have been toned down, and repetitive idle motions have been refined. The locomotion system has also been improved to feel smoother.[/p][p]Characters now tilt naturally when making turns and use a Look-at feature to face their direction of movement for enhanced realism.[/p][p]Additionally, Zois will make better eye contact with each other and interact more believably with objects, further enhancing immersion.
[/p][p][b]◽️(Animation) Fixed awkward animations that occurred during certain interactions[/b][/p][p][b]◽️(Animation) Improved animation quality for Cooking interactions to enhance immersion[/b][/p][p][b]◽️(Audio) Added Background Audio options in the Sound menu[/b][/p][p][b]◽️(Audio) Updated footsteps to reflect terrain[/b][/p][p][b]◽️(Audio) Added and refined sound effects to improve overall game immersion[/b][/p][p][b]◽️(Audio) Improved audio to prevent background music from overlapping with event-specific sounds[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ inZOI Cheats[/b][/h2][p]Cheats have been added to the game, letting you expand your creative horizons regardless of whether you're just starting out or already creating. You can bring your own unique situations to life by controlling various factors, including Zoi emotions, relationships, currency, movement, and environments.
[/p][p][b]◽️ Cheats can be accessed from the Psycat's Advice by using Enable Cheats feature. A detailed list of all available cheats can be found on the official website.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://playinzoi.com/guide/cheats"]https://playinzoi.com/guide/cheats[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ Canvas[/b][/h2][p][b]◽️Creations can now be set to Private (up to 10 creations allowed)[/b][/p][p][b]◽️Added pages that organize and display creator content by category.[/b][/p][p][b]◽️Added notification settings for Canvas interactions[/b][/p][p][b]◽️Updated and added various icons, including the Like and Heart buttons[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ UI/UX[/b][/h2][p]◽️ [b]Added a setting that allows players to choose from three UI size options: Small (default, 100%), Medium (112%), and Large (125%)[/b][/p][p][b]◽️ Updated choice cards to display profile images for both the sender and the receiver[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ Bug and Crash Fixes[/b][/h2][p]◽️ [b]Gameplay[/b][/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where your Zoi's current outfit failed to update accordingly when using City Appearance to change the weather[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where the Desired Life section in the Zoi Card did not immediately update after selecting Life of Self-Discovery[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where babies in idle families failed to load properly after their families moved house[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where Aging settings were not applied to newly created Zois[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where the main relationship status did not update correctly after a failed divorce attempt followed by another relationship selection[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where the same interaction appeared differently on desktops and laptops[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where the Announce Divorce interaction did not appear for children unaware of their parents' divorce[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where visual effects related to likes and dislikes failed to display correctly during interactions related to the Washing Cars preference[/p][p]◽️ [b]Career Interactions[/b][/p][p]　- Adjusted the Junior Lawyer's salary[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where some job-exclusive interactions failed to display job-related tags during workplace-related schedule events[/p][p]◽️ [b]Simulations[/b][/p][p]　- Fixed an issue related to the Make Food interaction[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where most interactions (such as Pick Up or Organize) were unavailable for certain crops, such as potatoes and corn.[/p][p]◽️ [b]Characters[/b][/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where eyebrows and beards were displayed incorrectly on Zois who are Middle-Aged or older[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where certain actions caused the chin gizmo to be positioned too far from a Zoi's chin in Detailed Editing[/p][p]◽️ [b]Building[/b][/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where certain grids on the first floor restricted movement on upper floors when creating buildings with two or more stories[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where Zois were unable to use stairs installed in rooms with elevated platforms[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where entering Build Mode while in the Hangyeol House property and returning to the game made doors unusable[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where exiting Build Mode after applying a basic property preset occasionally caused the game to crash[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where closing the UI while loading a My Texture caused the texture icon to appear white[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where deleting meshes of items created using the 3D Printer left behind ghost entries in the list[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where certain furniture filters were categorized incorrectly[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where applying a My Texture to a stair wall caused parts of the texture to appear incorrectly[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where, after changing a stair's appearance, the Material list in the Color and Material menu failed to update to match the new appearance[/p][p]◽️ [b]UI/UX[/b][/p][p]　- Fixed an issue with the Edit Family Tree menu[/p][p]　- Fixed an issue where performing certain actions would cause the in-game UI to disappear[/p][p]◽️ [b]Canvas[/b][/p][p]　- Fixed an Error Code: GREEN issue that prevented players from signing in to Canvas[/p][p]◽️ [b]Miscellaneous[/b][/p][p]　- Fixed typos and inaccurate descriptions[/p][p]◽️ [b]Crashes[/b][/p][p]　- Fixed an issue that caused occasional crashes when entering the game or selecting a property[/p][p]　- Action for GPU crashes that may occur under certain conditions[/p][list][*][p]We have improved the system so that when using a GPU of NVIDIA RTX 40 series (Ada Lovelace architecture) or higher and the "Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling" feature is turned off, a crash may intermittently occur and a pop-up guide will now appear prompting the user to enable the feature.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: July Known Issues (Last Updated: 07/2)
notes.content:
[h3][b]※ As of August, the Known Issues list is available and regularly maintained on the inZOI Forums.[/b][/h3][p][b]🔗 [/b][url="https://forum.playinzoi.com/t/august-known-issues/1612"]https://forum.playinzoi.com/t/august-known-issues/1612[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Hi Creators,  [/p][p]To provide a better gameplay experience, the inZOI team has continuously identified and addressed various issues throughout the development process.
[/p][p]The list below contains issues that the team is already aware of and fixing.
[/p][h2][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXciBb5xcohWKQhF_w9MdBy0WXuQ0gVsUUCHVmQ1SviAXZB-C7Im0wC5Frp3GFpjiNbjXB8gzDe-pbZnd4a74K0WyEPF8K52XRzSxqt_ExWhGPO5KGZg7Ewcj60JdyGRTREwhMYnLg?key=MkvqLmnwjP4LSRR_NijlJQ"][/img][/h2][h3][b]Gameplay [/b][/h3][list][*][p]In-game family tree editing may not be edited temporarily.[/p][/*][*][p]If an object is placed at the corner of a counter, the “Cook” interaction may be canceled.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Character[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Hairstyles may appear darker in-game than the color selected in CAZ depending on graphics settings. (7/2)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Build Mode[/b][/h3][list][*][p]When switching to Wall View mode, objects placed on wall shelves may remain visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusting roof height may cause the texture pattern to scale up or down unexpectedly.[/p][/*][*][p]When editing the base lot of Dowon Villa, it may be impossible to remove walls created near the entrance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Crash[/b][/h3][p]We’ve received reports that some players are still experiencing crashes following the hotfix on June 20. notes.title: inZOI ModKit AMA: Official Questions and Answers
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Creators.[/p][p]Thank you for sharing your questions and feedback during the inZOI ModKit AMA. Each submission has been carefully reviewed by our team, and we've decided to officially address a few of the most frequently asked questions.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Are there plans to improve how mods are presented and discovered in-game via the Mod Browser? For example, categories, tags, or creator pages?[/b][/p][p]We’re open to improving the usability of the Mod Browser. Suggestions such as categories, tags, and creator-specific pages are actively under review, and we are preparing to implement community feedback swiftly.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q. Now that monetization is not allowed in Inzoi. What is the company planning for future coz let's be real this is a half baked game and if I am putting lot of effort for designing a mod that not only enhances the gameplay but also builds on it's core, I need to be compensated as well. Without the modding community I don't believe it can pull players into the game. To summarise I just want to know what kind of support is the company going to provide for modders in the future.[/b][/p][p]inZOI’s modding policy does not permit direct monetization, such as paid mods or restricted access. This principle is intended to ensure that all players can enjoy content equally.[/p][p]However, we do recognize the time and effort involved in creating mods, and we are considering ways to support modders through indirect means. The following forms of monetization are currently allowed:[/p][p]- Ad revenue or donation requests on mod distribution platforms[/p][p]- Revenue from video content (e.g., tutorials or showcases) on platforms like YouTube

[/p][p]These methods allow modders to receive support for their work while still offering their mods for free, and we encourage such approaches.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Will there be scripting mods for inzoi?[/b][/p][p]Scripting mods for inZOI are currently in development and are planned to be included in the December update. We’re working to enable more flexible and expansive mod creation, so please stay tuned![/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Are custom makeups and skin texture in the roadmap? I see the modkit for face will be in September.[/b][/p][p]The ModKit to be released in June will not include dedicated features for customizing faces, makeup, or skin textures.[/p][p]However, creators familiar with the game’s data structure will be able to manually replace facial textures through data editing.[/p][p]A dedicated facial ModKit designed to make face modding more accessible is currently under development and is expected to be released after September.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Many of the most ambitious mods in the Sims require modification to the source code. For Inzoi, will you consider allowing modders to modify code to expand the creative range of mods outside what blueprints will provide?[/b][/p][p]We are currently developing scripting support for inZOI that will allow for more creative and complex mod development. Our goal is to provide a flexible system that meets the needs of our community.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. How much of the game will be moddable with the modding kit? From my understanding, you will release a sheet of the variables from the game which we can modify. In that sense, changing the game itself seems limited. Will we also be able to easily create interaction menus in the game and directly add for example new walk styles?[/b][/p][p]As of now, locomotion (such as walking styles) can be modified based on emotional states.[/p][p]While general states are more difficult to change, emotional states and life stages can be replaced or expanded, which includes the ability to swap out walk styles.[/p][p]If you want to trigger specific behaviors in certain contexts, combining various buff states is one possible method.[/p][p]Additionally, scripting mod support is currently in development to further enhance customization possibilities.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Hi devs, thanks for your transparent communication on mod kit. Will we eventually be able to export Zois from the game into Blender as well or will only the import be allowed?[/b][/p][p]Exporting user-created Zois as 3D asset files for Blender is not supported.[/p][p]However, the ModKit includes base Zoi body meshes and outfit samples, which can be used as references for creating custom clothing.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Is it only for modders or also beginners can create theirs own?[/b][/p][p]The ModKit launching in June has been designed with user-friendliness in mind, including a Wizard feature that helps beginners create CC items like outfits and furniture with ease.[/p][p]inZOI will also provide sample data and official tutorials to support anyone interested in creating their own content.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. You have mentioned that that you can make cc clothes with the modkit, will we be able to make our own jewellery from the start or will that be implemented in the future?[/b][/p][p]Yes, you will be able to create not only jewelry but other accessories as well. We will continue to enhance related ModKit features for easier access, and tutorials will be provided in the future to help guide you through the process.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. I wanted to share some ideas related to the ModKit and the upcoming in-game mod browser you mentioned in the May update. Since 3D modeling and rigging are already a part of the modding process, I was thinking—why not include a way to import poses and animations made from rigged 3D models? [/b][/p][p][b]What do you think about adding a new mod category for “Poses”? This could include subcategories like Solo Poses, Group Poses, Animated Poses, and Action-related Poses.[/b][/p][p]Currently, animation import is supported, and you can create rigged poses and animations using tools like Blender and apply them via data modding.[/p][p]We understand this can be challenging for beginners, so we are continually working to improve tutorials and guides to assist creators.[/p][p]Additionally, we are reviewing suggestions such as implementing categorized pose systems (e.g., solo, group, animated, or action-linked poses) and user-friendly features similar to a wizard.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Will the mod kit allow users to create Blender hair mods for Inzoi or will hair mods have to be created in Maya's XGen?[/b][/p][p]Hair mods can be created using mesh card-based styles, which are commonly used in games.[/p][p]However, XGen Groom hair (typically used for cinematic rendering) is not supported at this time.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Inzoi support 8192px texture?[/b][/p][p]There are no specific restrictions on using high-resolution textures such as 8192px.[/p][p]However, for performance and optimization reasons, we recommend using textures sized 2048x2048 (2K) or smaller whenever possible.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Would it be possible to control NPCs with script for tasks?
 For example, I'm designing plants for the garden. I'd like an NPC that controls the soil moisture via a script and waters the plants when needed. Will such scripts be possible?[/b][/p][p]The game currently supports lightweight scripting functions that allow for some control over NPC behavior.[/p][p]However, since a "soil" object does not exist in the game at this time, the described functionality would need to be implemented using a workaround.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Will modders be allowed to offer their mods in the form of early access (like for 2–3 weeks)? A lot of time & money goes into making mods, so this will greatly help modders offset these development costs that occur when creating.[/b][/p][p]Mods shared on official inZOI-supported platforms must be available to all users for free, and paywalled distribution of mods in the form of early access is not allowed.[/p][p]That said, we fully understand the time and effort involved in mod development.[/p][p]While early access is not allowed through our official platforms, alternative methods such as passive ads, donation requests, or monetized video content on platforms like YouTube may be used to support your work.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Hello, I am a 3D designer and I would like to know if it is going to be possible for me to create my accessories in Rhino and import it in your modkit to make it work in the game? Also how can we manage textures? Would it be necessary for me to create textures maps in blender or your modkit will facilitate this process? Thank you for your effort![/b][/p][p]Models created in Rhino and other 3D tools can be converted to FBX format and imported into the inZOI ModKit.[/p][p]You can create textures using professional software such as Blender or Photoshop. Please refer to the sample data included in the ModKit to ensure your assets follow the appropriate structure for inZOI.[/p][p]We recommend reviewing the official documentation for detailed workflows and important guidelines before starting your work.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Will it be possible to use cloth physics when creating outfits? Current game content does not have it enabled, but some existing mods do offer this option even if not 100% compatible due to limitations in modding tools. I am eager to explore the modkit to create clothes/hair and this option would really improve aesthetics for some garments eg: dresses, long coats, capes, hair etc. imho. Thank you[/b][/p][p]Cloth physics is not currently supported in the ModKit Wizard. However, you can implement cloth and hair movement using Unreal Engine’s Cloth Simulation. For hair, rigid body simulation can be achieved using the DA_HairRigidBody system.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. I don't know exactly where to put this, but can you allow us modders to categorize items? If we want to upload a self-made necklace from Blender now, we have to upload a whole "outfit preset". It would be so much easier if we could at least categorize it as jewelry/accessory etc.[/b][/p][p]We completely understand your concern. We are planning to gradually introduce more detailed category options after the ModKit is released.[/p][p]  [/p][p][b]Q. At present, I think it is strange that JSON support is from June, but InZOI's localization function is from December. Please tell me if December localization refers to ModKit localization or mod localization function.[/b][/p][p]The localization feature coming in December refers to multilingual modding that allows the game language to be changed to languages not officially supported by inZOI’s 13-language set.[/p][p]In June, you’ll be able to edit names and descriptions of furniture in your preferred language when creating furniture mods.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. I have questions about the Blender/Maya kits. Will avatar body types be shared (male, female, baby, teen)?[/b][/p][p][b]If I create clothes or furniture mods, will my creator name be shown? For example, if a user named A uploads a mod, can user B re-upload it and claim it as their own (reposting/repacking)?[/b][/p][p][b]Also, is it possible to upload mods privately, just for personal testing or solo use without making them publicly downloadable?[/b][/p][p]◽️ Avatar Body Types[/p][p]　- The ModKit released in June includes sample body meshes for adult males, adult females, and children.

[/p][p]◽️ Mod Credits and Protection Against Reposting[/p][p]　- Currently, the system does not automatically display creator names in mod files, so it’s not possible to fully prevent others from re-uploading and claiming ownership of your work. [/p][p]　- However, we are actively exploring features to help address this issue.

[/p][p]◽️ Private Use of Mods[/p][p]　- You can absolutely create and apply mods for personal use only via local storage. [/p][p]　- Sharing your mods publicly is entirely optional.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Will it be possible to modify/access the post-process materials and post-process volumes? For example, to change the final render to a cel-shaded style or to add outlines to the meshes.[/b][/p][p]At this time, modifying or accessing post-process materials and volumes is not supported.[/p][p]We anticipate these features may become available in future updates.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Will it be possible to add more vehicle-related mods? I’d also love to see more realistic driving mechanics.[/b][/p][p]While vehicle appearances can currently be customized through the ModKit, functional modding such as driving mechanics is still under internal review.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Will inZOI support customizing gameplay, character animations, body shapes, text, voice, and relationship systems?[/b][/p][p]At present, gameplay and some in-game text can be modified through data modding.[/p][p]Character animations, body types, voice lines, and relationship mechanics are not yet supported, but we plan to expand support for these features through future updates.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Are there plans to support mods that edit public spaces or other NPC households? Some areas currently lack stairs or editable shared lots.[/b][/p][p]Currently, modding features related to city backgrounds or public zones are not officially supported.[/p][p]However, our development team is aware of the need for such functionality and is exploring possible technical solutions.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Will we be able to create scripts that change ZOI behaviors or object interactions? I’m especially interested in interacting with their thoughts or accessing APIs for that.[/b][/p][p]Scripting mods are currently in development. In the meantime, the Data Editor allows for partial control over interaction elements.[/p][p]For example, you can modify dialogue choices and their outcomes to change gameplay flow.[/p][p]We plan to expand these capabilities further through future script modding support.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Can we upload mods that import models from other games to CurseForge? What about using them as references instead of direct imports?[/b][/p][p]inZOI respects creative freedom above all when it comes to mod development. All rights and ownership of user-created mods belong to the original modder—not to inZOI.[/p][p]If your mod includes assets ported or inspired by other games, please exercise caution when sharing, as you are solely responsible for any Intellectual property-related issues that may arise.[/p][p]When uploading mods to platforms such as CurseForge, please note that moderation policies may apply. Depending on the platform’s guidelines, your mod may be restricted or removed.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Will you add a map editor like in Warcraft III so players can create full gameplay modes? With inZOI’s asset quality, I see great potential.
[/b] Currently, modding is limited to certain features.
 That said, we are actively exploring broader expansion options and hope to offer a more open creative environment based on suggestions from our Creator community.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. How open will inZOI become to mod developers in the future? Will the game be fully accessible in terms of resources and tools?[/b][/p][p]We aim to provide as much access to game resources as possible, within the limits of copyright and security considerations.[/p][p]Our team is continuously reviewing ways to support creators in utilizing inZOI’s assets creatively and responsibly.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Does the ModKit support Chinese? How many languages are available? Will tutorials be available in Chinese as well?[/b][/p][p]The ModKit is currently provided in English, but tutorial videos include Chinese subtitles.[/p][p]We plan to gradually expand support for additional languages, including Chinese.[/p][p]  [/p][p][b]Q. Are there any plans to integrate with the Steam Workshop? It’s a very convenient platform for distributing and managing mods.[/b][/p][p]There are currently no plans for Steam Workshop integration.[/p][p]However, we may consider it in the future depending on community demand and feasibility.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q. Will the ModKit or mods be optimized for low-end PCs?[/b][/p][p]The ModKit itself is not specifically optimized for low-end PCs. [/p][p]However, creators can take optimization into account when designing mods, such as by adjusting resource sizes and settings accordingly.[/p][p]
[/p][p]If you have any additional questions or suggestions regarding the inZOI ModKit, please let us know through our community channels. We will continue to work towards improving the overall gameplay experience based on your feedback.[/p][p]Thank you,[/p][p]The inZOI Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Kjun's Letter: A Sneak Peek at the June Gameplay Update
notes.content:
Hello, Creators.


Kjun here.


Before we dive in, I'd like to once again sincerely apologize to all the Creators who were eagerly awaiting the May update. Moving forward, we'll do our best to share updates in a timely manner. inZOI's June update is scheduled for release on June 13 (Friday), and we're committed to making it one that's worth the wait.


This update will include previously announced modding features (ModKit), key features from the roadmap revealed during the showcase, other various new content additions, system improvements, and bug fixes. Here's a sneak peak at what you can expect to see.


[h2]Updates to Family and Relationship Systems[/h2]
◆ More Ways to Build Families
　◽️ Zois can now have children regardless of marital status. One new method of doing so, adoption, was originally planned to have various prerequisites. However, to allow players to form families more freely, we chose to simplify the system by minimizing the required conditions. In addition, you will be able to select a Zoi with your desired traits and have a child using their genetic information through medical procedures. We hope these features will give you the freedom to create families in your own way.
◆ Teenage Romance
　◽️ Teenage Zois can now engage in romantic interactions with one another. That said, looking back, I personally wish we could have made Teenager and Adult Zois appear more visually distinct from each other.
◆ Romantic Relationships with Everyone
　◽️ A feature that was still in development at the time of early access release, Zois can now form romantic relationships with any other Zoi in the city. To enable this feature, go to the Create a Zoi screen and click the Change Gender Identity button to adjust your Zoi's settings.
◆ Sending the First Text
　◽️ Player Zois can now start conversations via text message. While you won't be able to write custom messages, your Zoi can send texts to other Zois to make plans with them as their relationships grow. We hope to develop a feature someday that allows you to write your own messages as well.

[h2]Quality-of-Life and Simulation Improvements[/h2]
◆ UI Size Settings
　◽️ In response to player feedback regarding UI visibility, we've added a setting with three different options that allows you to adjust the size of UI elements and text.
◆ Cheats
　◽️ Cheats can now be used in-game. While the number of cheats currently available is somewhat limited, we will work to add more in future updates.
◆ Lifestyle-Based Changes to Body Weight and Muscle Mass
　◽️ Zois will now undergo changes in physique based on their lifestyle choices, offering a more realistic and dynamic gameplay experience. Overeating will cause Zois to gain weight, and working out will cause them to build muscle.
◆ Exchanging Items
　◽️ Zois can now exchange items with each other, opening the door for more interactions. You will be able to gift, give, or sell items from your Zoi's bag.

[h2]New Items and Creative Tools[/h2]
◆ Over 20 New Character Studio Assets Added
　◽️ New items for character customization have been added, including highly requested additions to hair-related assets as well as new outfits and accessories.
◆ Over 100 New Furniture Items Added
　◽️ More than 100 unique furniture items have been added, including items for kitchens, bedrooms, and babies.

In addition to these features, we're also making overall improvements, both big and small, to sound settings, Canvas, animations, simulation, and other parts of the game. 
Our team remains committed to listening to your feedback and working to deliver a better game experience. We hope the upcoming June 13 update makes your experience with inZOI even more enjoyable. 
Thank you again for your continued interest and support.


Thank you.
- Kjun

Please refer to the schedule and submission method below.
 
◆ ModKit AMA Schedule
　◽️ Question Submission Period

　　- Submit your questions via the Google Form linked in this announcement.

　　- Responses to frequently asked and notable questions will be shared on Discord, Steam, and the official website at 08:00 UTC on June 9, 2025.

notes.title: Kjun’s Letter: Update Schedule Change and ModKit Notice
notes.content:
Hello, Creators.

Kjun here.

Today, I’d like to explain how your valuable feedback is being reflected in the game and also share an update regarding the schedule change for the update initially planned for May.
 
[h3]1. Player Feedback Channels[/h3]
Your feedback is always our most important starting point.
We review feedback and bug reports submitted through channels like Discord, Steam, and customer support (CS) on a daily basis. We don't just collect opinions — we also examine the context of the feedback and how many players have had similar experiences.
Although we cannot implement every suggestion immediately, we prioritize them based on frequency and impact. For bugs, we assess whether the issue is unresolvable by the player or whether it frequently disrupts immersion. We will continue to clarify this prioritization process and improve how we communicate with you around how feedback is reflected in the game.
 
[h3]2. Update Delay and Additional Modding Details[/h3]
We sincerely apologize to those who were waiting for the May update.
The update that was originally planned for the end of May, including the modding system, has been postponed to mid-June. We felt there were still areas that needed improvement, and we wanted to prioritize quality over speed. Although the schedule has shifted, we are working to deliver content that’s truly satisfying.
 
There have also been some misconceptions circulating about the ModKit since we shared early details. We’ve spent a long time internally exploring the best structure to support modding, and based on your feedback, we realized we needed to explain it more clearly.
 
The ModKit is a tool designed to help you create mods. Its purpose is to make it easier to create mod content and allow for more flexible sharing. 
While inZOI includes a built-in CurseForge integration, we’ve broadened support so that creators can share mods in two ways:
　1. You can upload your mod to CurseForge and install it through the in-game Mod Browser.
　2. Or, you can save the mod locally and move it to the Documents\inZOI\Mods folder to use it manually.
This system aims to support creative freedom and expression, not just mod sharing.
We believe inZOI is only complete when enhanced by the creativity of each individual creator. Our goal is to provide an open and supportive environment for everyone to bring their worlds to life.
 
The June update will include the following modding features:
　◽️ A convenient tool to edit or replace graphics for set outfits and furniture
　◽️ Developer-accessible JSON files to customize game settings and logic
　◽️ Sample projects that demonstrate how to create clothing, hairstyles, furniture, and interactions
 
For beginners, we’re also offering the CAZ Wizard tool specifically for set outfit modding. This helps new modders get started more easily.
While data-based modding is possible for all outfit types beyond sets, we are preparing a separate tutorial guide due to its structural complexity. We plan to continue expanding support so creators of all skill levels can participate.
Some features — including scripting — won’t be available at the initial ModKit launch, as development is still ongoing.
We ask for your understanding and promise to deliver a high-quality ModKit as soon as possible.
 
[h3]3. Game Content Improvements[/h3]
Alongside modding, we are also working to improve how Zois express emotions and show personality in the June update.
During our work on emotional stability in the April update, we discovered some unexpected side effects. Currently, some Zois freeze or fail to reflect emotions through facial expressions or behaviors — this will be addressed in June.
We also heard feedback that Zois sometimes lack distinctiveness in their behavior. We’re adding emotion-based conversations and reactions, so that even the same actions vary depending on emotional state.
 
For example, a sad Zoi might 'cry in the bathroom.' Certain interactions may be more or less likely depending on mood, and even eating may differ based on emotions or needs.
This is just the beginning. We want Zois to develop unique personalities over time, and respond more naturally based on their emotional state.
We are committed to evolving this system long-term.
We can’t wait to see what kind of worlds you create with inZOI. We truly support and celebrate your imagination. To everyone who’s been waiting for the May update — thank you, and we’ll be back with the June update very soon.


Thank you.
- Kjun

notes.title: Notice on the Use of Generative AI in inZOI
notes.content:
Hello, Creators.


Recently, there has been growing interest and various discussions in the community regarding the use of generative AI technologies used in inZOI. To provide clear and accurate information, we would like to share the following details.
 
[b][Text to Image (T2I) Technology][/b]
The Text to Image (T2I) technology applied in inZOI was trained using publicly available images that are permitted for commercial use.
Over the course of several months, we built our own dataset by selecting 20 million images from public images released under Creative Commons licenses permitting commercial use and modification.
In this process, we referred to MOSAICML’s Common Canvas methodology and applied additional filtering standards to enhance reliability.
For model training we used open-source AI architectures licensed for commercial use.
 
[b][3D Printing AI Technology][/b]
Our 3D printing AI technology was trained on approximately 46,000 high-quality 3D models either owned by us or sourced from datasets that are also permitted for commercial use.
This enables users to automatically generate blueprints for in-game 3D printing.
 
[b][Video-to-Motion Technology][/b]
The Video-to-Motion(V2M) system was trained primarily on over 1.7 million motion data samples owned and collected by us supplemented with a limited number of publicly available datasets released under open licenses.
As a result, the V2M system enables characters to naturally perform human-like movements such as walking, greeting others, and dancing.
 
[b][Our Development Principles][/b]
As we developed and applied generative AI technologies, we generally employed the following principles:
[list]
[*] Use of open-source technologies licensed for commercial use
[*] Use of carefully selected datasets permitted for commercial use
[*] Operation of a robust reporting and review system to address any potential claims swiftly and responsibly
[/list]
 
We wanted to share this for transparency, as part of our effort to deliver technologies that creators trust.


Thank you,
The inZOI Team

notes.title: Kjun's Letter: Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
Hello, Creators.
Kjun here.


In this letter, I'll be sharing our plans for features currently in development, as well as the direction we want to take inZOI in the future.


Our team has spent the past month carefully reviewing and addressing frequently reported issues, including build stability, awkward emotional expressions, and a lack of depth in the Karma system. This experience has helped us once again realize how important convincing emotions and behavior is for a life simulation game. Thankfully, some players have responded positively to these fixes by expressing that emotions and conversations now feel more natural, which we truly appreciate. That said, there's still plenty of room for improvement, so we remain committed to making inZOI a better experience for players.


In addition to our ongoing hotfixes, we're actively working on the May and August updates. The May update will introduce long-awaited modding features to the game. While these features won't support creating entirely new systems from scratch at launch, they will allow you to modify key in-game data and settings. We're also preparing official plug-ins for Blender and Maya to make creating custom outfits and furniture easier, as well as features that allow players to work with various asset types such as textures, meshes, FX, and MetaSounds. Guidelines for creating assets will be shared via tutorial videos and the modding UI. We plan on continuing to expand modding support and aim to have all core features in place by December.


With a third city coming to the game, we're also exploring new challenges. We've recognized the community's desire for more gameplay depth and we will work towards offering content with the potential for richer storytelling and more engaging experiences. To match the vibe of the new city, we will be introducing smaller vehicles, such as motorcycles, along with highly requested vehicle personalization features. Since these will build upon our existing vehicle systems, some animations may seem slightly awkward at first. However, we believe that this will allow players to experience the thrill of weaving through the city on a smaller ride, enhancing both the storytelling and atmosphere aspects. We will continue to put our best effort into developing something that feels truly worthwhile.


While we made some adjustments to the Karma system in the previous hotfix, we will continue to refine and expand on it. To address the lack of meaningful consequences, we're currently planning new crime-related content that allows Zois to be caught and go to jail, spawning additional events as a result. Our goal is to create deeper gameplay experiences where Karma-based interactions lead to logical, connected outcomes. If you have any fun or creative ideas, let us know in the #inzoi-feedback channel on our Discord!


Finally, we've noticed growing interest and discussion within our community surrounding inZOI's use of AI. We will be addressing this topic in a separate announcement, and will continue to prioritize transparency and trust to allow players to continue enjoying inZOI.


While inZOI is far from perfect, we are working day and night to make it a true life simulation game through imagination, consideration, and experimentation. Every piece of feedback from each of our players helps point us in the right direction. We will continue listening closely to our community, so please don't hesitate to share your thoughts with us.


Last but not least, I'd like to express my heartfelt appreciation for your continued support.


Thank you.
- Kjun

notes.title: Kjun's Letter: Looking Back on inZOI's Early Access Release
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Kjun here.
Long time, no talk!

There's been so much I've wanted to share with you all since inZOI's Early Access release.

Today, I'd like to go over a few of those thoughts, as well as share how we plan to communicate with the community moving forward.

We released inZOI in Early Access so we could share it with you as soon as possible, however imperfect. Our goal has always been to shape the game together by using your feedback to create the best possible experience.

That's why continuing the connections and conversations that we have with all of you is just as important to us as developing the game itself. To honor that spirit of collaboration, we plan to communicate with our community more frequently and openly going forward.

As the first step forward, I'd like to share our future plans for communication.

[h2][b]Future Communication Plans[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]"Kjun's Letter": Musings from myself and the inZOI Team[/b][/h3]
Starting today, I'll be sharing my thoughts and reflections on the development of inZOI with you all. While the format will be similar to "Kjun's Concerns," I hope to go beyond just my concerns and also touch on more personal and in-depth topics. More importantly, I want to discuss the feedback, suggestions, and honest opinions we've received, as well as our future plans for the game, so stay tuned!

[h3][b]"Monthly Known Issues": Details on Known Issues[/b][/h3]
We'll be sharing a list of known issues every month, and we'll continue to make improvements to the overall gameplay experience based on your feedback.

[h3][b]"inZOI @": Previews of New Content[/b][/h3]
As mentioned during the March showcase, we have a variety of new content planned for future release. We'll be offering previews and live Q&A sessions before each release to give you a closer look into upcoming content.

[h2][b]Looking Back on inZOI's Development[/b][/h2]
inZOI has been a completely new challenge for both me and the team. We've stepped into a genre that was unfamiliar to us and experimented with new approaches, getting this far through trial, error and collaboration. It's been a true learning experience, albeit one that's left plenty of room for improvement.

In addition to the upcoming hotfixes, we're working hard to prepare new content for the May and August updates. Though we've still got a long way to go, we hope to reward the trust and patience you've shown us.

To us, you're more than just players—you're partners who share our vision, walking this path together with us as one team. Your support and passion keep us going and give us a reason to push forward.

Of course, we're aware that the road ahead isn't an easy one. Nonetheless, we're committed to working on finishing the game, one step at a time.

To be honest, releasing inZOI left me with many complicated feelings. In many ways, putting a game out into the world feels a lot like becoming a parent.

Creating something new frees you from the world and its many expectations. You feel a true connection with what you've made, one so deep that it blurs the line between creator and creation. It's a truly profound experience.

Of course, that joy comes with its share of pain. As joyful as it is when the world embraces your creation, it hurts just as much when it doesn't. But perhaps that pain is simply just another part of being a creator. I'd even call it a pain worth having.

Regardless, we've only made it this far thanks to you. Thank you once again for supporting inZOI.

I'll be back soon to share more thoughts. In the meantime, please enjoy the game, and let us know what you think!

Thank you.
- Kjun
