notes.title: Regarding the inZOI Update Roadmap and Our Communication Plans
notes.content:
Hello, Creators.

We have seen concerns in the community about the “short break” mentioned in my recent letter of gratitude to players. To be clear, the inZOI team’s “short break” was just two days of vacation. We apologize for causing worry with our vague wording.

We are aware of the wide range of feedback and improvement requests you have shared. Additional hotfix patches are scheduled for this week, and we are continuing to monitor feedback and develop builds. We are prioritizing fixing various bugs and issues that disrupt gameplay. But to reassure you about our dedication to making inZOI a better game, we would like to share our future update plans and how we will communicate them.
[b]
[Short-Term Update Plans][/b]
As explained in our online showcase, we originally planned content updates for inZOI about once every two months during Early Access.

However, given the spirit of Early Access — completing the game together with you — we intend to quickly apply fixes for reported issues through hotfixes during April.

These short-term updates are smaller in scale compared to major updates, but we expect that rolling out content faster and incorporating feedback more promptly will have a more positive effect on your gameplay experience. 

Additionally, whenever we identify critical issues, we plan to keep addressing them through hotfixes. As mentioned, we want to stay true to our words about not taking advantage of the term  “Early Access”, and show gratitude to those who purchased the game by continuing to release updates and maintain open communication.

We will continue to wait for and welcome your feedback. 

[b][Feedback Channels and Communication Plans][/b]
Currently, you can provide category-specific feedback via the #inzoi-feedback channel on our Discord server. If you do not see the channel listed, please check the “Browse Channels” or “Channel & Roles” options in the navigation menu to enable it.

Our team is exploring more efficient ways to gather and organize feedback. We are also preparing a survey so that we can collect a wider range of opinions on future updates. We would greatly appreciate your participation.

We are likewise examining new ways for two-way communication between the inZOI team and the community. The AMA we held in February was indeed a memorable experience for us, but we are also looking into other options that can better accommodate all time zones and languages.

Although we have launched multiple games and communicated with communities before, the passionate and large-scale global community of inZOI is a next-level experience for us, and we are going through some trial and error in finding the optimal means of communication.

Despite this, we want to express our sincere gratitude once again to all creators who continue to support the inZOI Team.

We will do our best to circle back with even more exciting news next time.

Thank you,
 — Kjun

notes.title: Tips on Optimal Settings for the Best Experience
notes.content:
Hello, Creators.


To accommodate a wide range of PC specifications and playstyles, we’ve prepared two recommended setting options.  
One prioritizes smooth performance with reduced system load, while the other delivers the highest graphical fidelity for a more immersive experience.

[b]1. Better Performance (Frame Rates)[/b]  
Prioritizes uninterrupted gameplay and faster simulations, reducing system load for higher FPS.

[b](1) Resolution[/b]  
- Lowering resolution significantly reduces GPU load.  
- Choose one of the following to reduce the strain caused by high resolution.  
[list]
[*]Lowering Resolution Scale reduces GPU load similarly to reducing the resolution itself.  
[*]Setting DLSS/FSR/XeSS to Ultra Performance or Performance can greatly boost frame rates.  
[*]Dynamic Resolution lets the system automatically lower resolution to maintain stable FPS.  
[/list]
[b](2) Graphics[/b]  
- Setting the preset to Very Low or Low can greatly increase frame rates but reduces texture and visual effect quality.  
- Reducing Shader Quality, Background Detail Quality, and Shadow Quality especially helps improve performance.  

[b](3) Ray Tracing (RT)[/b]  
- Disabling ray tracing cuts down on GPU load from lighting calculations, raising FPS.  
- Switching Ray Tracing Target to Fallback Mesh can yield a big performance gain, though high-end systems may crash.  

[b](4) Storage and Memory[/b]  
- Installing the game on an SSD lowers the strain from texture streaming and map loading, enhancing overall performance.  
- Increasing system memory or virtual memory can also alleviate FPS drops caused by insufficient resources.  


[b]2. Better Graphics[/b]  
Focuses on sharper and more detailed visuals but at higher system cost.

[b](1) Resolution[/b]  
- Higher resolution offers more detailed graphics.  
- Choose from these approaches to enhance resolution.  
[list]
[*]Increasing Resolution Scale brings the display closer to your monitor's native res.  
[*]Setting DLSS/FSR/XeSS to Quality or Off preserves detail near the original resolution.  
[*]Dynamic Resolution helps maintain visuals near that native resolution.  
[/list]
[b](2) Graphics[/b]  
- Selecting High or Ultra in the presets improves texture, lighting, and shader quality.  
- For even more realistic visuals, set Shader Quality, Background Detail Quality, and Shadow Quality to their highest.  

[b](3) Ray Tracing (RT)[/b]  
- Enabling ray tracing greatly enhances reflections and shadows.  
- Keeping Ray Tracing Target as Actual Mesh yields more realistic visuals.  

[b](4) Storage and Memory[/b]  
- Installing on an SSD accelerates texture streaming and map loading, allowing smoother play even on high settings.  
- Sufficient system memory (or virtual memory) keeps high-resolution textures and details stable.  


We hope these settings help you find the best fit for your PC and playstyle.  
Our team continues to refine auto-adjust features and optimize performance for a more enjoyable experience.


Thank you,  
The inZOI Team

notes.title: Regarding the Removal of Denuvo from inZOI (Updated)
notes.content:
[i]Some of our past statements about Denuvo have been removed from the announcement after a careful discussion with the Denuvo team, as it may create somewhat unfounded preconceptions about their service. However, this does NOT change our decision about removing Denuvo, and our wayahead remains unchanged.[/i]

Hello,
This is Kjun, Producer & Director of inZOI.

Recently, we’ve seen growing concern around the implementation of the Denuvo anti-tamper solution in inZOI. While we wanted to respond as quickly as possible, we also felt it was important to approach the issue with care—consulting with teams from around the world to make a thoughtful and informed decision. We sincerely apologize for the delay in providing this official response.

To address the most important point: we have decided to remove Denuvo from the Early Access build of inZOI.

We initially chose to implement Denuvo as a way to protect the game from illegal distribution. At the time, we believed this would help ensure fairness for players who had properly purchased the game. However, after taking a closer look at community feedback, we quickly realized that this approach did not align with what our players wanted.

Our initial application of Denuvo on our main development build made it so that the inZOI: Creative Studio demo build, a branch from the main build, was also applied with the same anti-tamper. Unfortunately, we failed to properly inform our players of this application during the demo period, and we sincerely apologize for that oversight.

We understand that removing Denuvo increases the risk of the game being cracked and illegally distributed after release. At the same time, we believe it opens up a valuable opportunity: it allows inZOI to become more freely configurable—unlocking new ways for players to shape new experiences for other players. We believe enabling this freedom from the very beginning will lead to innovative and long-lasting enjoyment for the community.

As I mentioned during the Online Showcase, we are committed to making inZOI a highly moddable game. Our first stage of official mod support will launch in May, allowing players to use tools like Maya and Blender to create custom content. But this is only the beginning. Over time, we plan to expand mod support across more areas of the game, so you can customize and enhance your experience in many different ways. (More information on modding will be shared in a separate post.)

As a development team committed to putting players first, the decision to remove the anti-tamper solution became a clear one. We will continue to prioritize your feedback and make well-informed decisions throughout our Early Access development.

We want to sincerely apologize for not aligning more closely with player expectations on this sensitive issue. We regret the concern and confusion this has caused within the community, and we’re committed to rebuilding your trust as we move forward in developing the best possible experience.

Thank you so much for your continued love and support. Please keep sharing your feedback, as it truly helps us make inZOI better for everyone.

Sincerely,
Kjun

notes.title: inZOI: Creative Studio - How to handle Known Issues
notes.content:
Hi, Creators!


We’ve been receiving some recurring questions from you all, so here’s a quick guide to help clarify a few things!

If you’re experiencing any of the following issues, please check the information below:

[hr][/hr]

[b]1. Facial Capture isn’t working – What should I check?[/b]

If you are having trouble with Facial Capture,

[list]
[*]Make sure you are using an iOS device, as facial capture is only supported on iOS.  
[list][*] Facial Capture is supported on iOS 16.0 or later.[/list][*]Ensure both your iOS device and PC are connected to the same network.
[*]Check your Windows Defender Firewall settings.  
[list][*] Go to Firewall and change the network from Public to Private.[/list][/list]

[b]2. Seeing a “Missing File Privileges” error when installing via Steam?[/b]

This is often caused by Steam’s download cache. Here’s how to clear it:

[list]
[*]In the Steam Client, click [Steam] > [Settings] in the top-left menu.
[*]Select the [Downloads] tab and Click the [Clear Download Cache] button at the bottom.
[*]Select [Confirm] to proceed. (Note: You’ll need to log back into Steam afterwards!)
[/list]

If the error still occurs, it may be related to your system specifications or available memory.  
Please check the [url=https://playinzoi.com/system_requirements]System Requirements[/url] Page and submit a ticket via [url=https://support.playinzoi.com]Customer Support Page[/url] for further assistance.


[b]3. Getting “Invalid request.” message when uploading on Canvas?[/b]

To protect the Canvas system, uploads may be temporarily restricted if there are too many attempts in a short time.

The restriction will lift automatically 24 hours after it begins. Please try again later.


[b]4. The game resolution looks off. How can I fix it?[/b]

If unexpectedly low resolution or stretched screens when launching the game happens, try adjusting the resolution manually using the steps below:

[list]
[*]Open the config file located at:  
[list][*][i]C:\Users\{YourUsername}\AppData\Local\BlueClient\Saved\Config\Windows[/i][/list][*]Modify the values in the file
[/list]

[b]5. Getting “Your creation's file size exceeds the maximum limit. Please upload a smaller file.” when uploading on Canvas?[/b]

It may occur when the content you're trying to upload exceeds the allowed file size limit for Canvas. 

This usually means the creation is too large to be uploaded.

Please try reducing the number of included elements such as items, assets, or images to lower the file size.

[hr][/hr]

Let us know if you run into anything else—we’re always listening!

Thank you! 
The inZOI Team

notes.title: System Requirements and Optimal Settings for inZOI
notes.content:
Greetings, Creators! 



inZOI delivers high-quality graphics and realistic city-level simulations, which require higher system specifications to run smoothly.


While [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2456740/inZOI/]the minimum and recommended system requirements are already listed on our Steam page[/url], 
we wanted to provide a more detailed and comprehensible breakdown of these specifications and how they might impact your gameplay experience. 

As such, we've categorized the system requirements into four tiers and provided the optimal game settings for each tier. 



[h2]1. Minimum, Medium, Recommended, High[/h2]

[img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/staging/common/news/20250311/GGJJ6OO9.png[/img]



[h2]2. Optimal Settings[/h2]

[h3]a. What are optimal settings?[/h3]

[img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/staging/common/news/20250311/CULlodWE.PNG[/img]

Optimal settings ensure you experience the game on your current PC in the best possible way. 

Since inZOI was developed using Unreal Engine 5, adjusting the game's settings can lead to significantly different experiences, even on systems with identical specifications. 


Let's explore how different factors impact gameplay and which settings you'll need experience inZOI in the best way possible. 


[h3]b. Which factors affect optimal settings? [/h3]

Higher resolutions put more load on the GPU as they require rendering a greater number of pixels. 

For reference:[list][*]1920×1080 (FHD) = 2,070,000 pixels[*]2560×1440 (QHD) = 3,680,000 pixels (about 1.77x more than FHD)[*]3840×2160 (4K) = 8,290,000 pixels (4x more than FHD!)[*]Rendering in 4K requires four times the number of pixels as FHD, significantly increasing GPU processing load and reducing frame rates. 
Higher resolutions also demand more VRAM, which can lead to shortages due to increased buffer sizes.[/list]

SSDs may also affect optimal settings by offering:[list][*]Faster data transfer speeds than HDDs, leading to reduced loading times for maps and resources during gameplay[*]Improved texture streaming to help reduce texture pop-ins and maintain high-quality graphics[*]Fewer frame drops for a smoother gameplay experience[*]Faster installation and update times[/list]

[h3]c. I'm not familiar with the technical details. How should I set up my settings?[/h3]

We've prepared eight different preset options tailored to four system tiers and various gameplay preferences. 

The settings for the Recommended and High tiers are optimized for 4K monitors.

We understand that all of this might be a bit overwhelming.

[h2]4. Our Commitment[/h2]

As mentioned earlier, inZOI delivers high-quality graphics and realistic city-level simulations, which require higher system specifications. 

While these requirements ensure the best possible gameplay experience, we remain committed to making inZOI accessible to more players.  

We plan to implement a feature that automatically adjusts game settings to provide the best possible experience. 

Additionally, we will continue working on optimizations to improve performance while finding ways to lower system requirements without compromising overall quality.

inZOI is still in preparation for early access, which means there's room for improvement. 

Some aspects of the current version may feel somewhat limited in both quantity and quality. 

Our team is committed to enhancing the inZOI experience for Creators. 

We truly appreciate your patience and continued support, and we look forward to seeing you in early access!

The inZOI Team

notes.title: inZOI Discord AMA Summary
notes.content:
Hello, Creators!


We sincerely thank everyone who joined the AMA on February 28th in the official inZOI Discord. 

Thanks to your enthusiastic interest and questions, it was a truly meaningful session.


The key topics covered in this AMA were as follows:


[b]🛠️ Gameplay Features & Mechanics[/b]

[b]Can we adjust Zoi heights?[/b]
❌ No, Zois' heights cannot be adjusted.
🔹 [b]Why?[/b] The game uses [b]pre-programmed animations[/b], and adjusting heights would disrupt interactions (e.g., handshakes or hugging).


[b]Will Zois be able to multitask?[/b]
🔹 [b]Planned for the future[/b], but not available at [b]Early Access (EA) launch.[/b]
🔹 Many of the game’s [b]single-action animations have been improved[/b], but full multitasking is still in development.


[b]How many Zois can be in a family?[/b]
🔹 [b]Maximum of 8 Zois per family.[/b]
🔹 If the household is full, [b]pregnancy attempts will fail[/b] unless [b]a family member dies.[/b]


[b]Will Zois have a memory?[/b]
🔹 [b]Not yet implemented, [/b]but a similar [b]recording system for major life events[/b] (e.g., marriages, divorces) exists.
🔹 The [b]long-term goal[/b] is to create a [b]memory-like system[/b] that allows Zois to recall past interactions.

 
[b]How do jobs work in inZOI?[/b]
🔹 [b]Active job system – No more "rabbit hole" jobs[/b] where Zois just disappear for work.
🔹 Work involves [b]going to the workplace, interacting with coworkers, getting promotions, and more.[/b]
🔹 [b]Freelance jobs[/b] (e.g., authors) allow flexible, work-from-home options.

 
[b]Will there be an active school system?[/b]
❌ [b]Not at EA launch[/b] due to complexity.
🔹 The inZOI team wants [b]a fully immersive school experience[/b] (e.g., cafeteria interactions, friendships, and conflicts).
🔹 It [b]will be added later, but no timeline yet.[/b]

 
[b]Will pets be included in Early Access?[/b]
❌[b] No pets at EA launch.[/b]
🔹 Pets are [b]a high priority for future updates[/b] but require extensive development for proper interactions.


[b]🖌️ Customization & Modding[/b]

[b]Can we use mods?[/b]
✅ [b]Yes![/b] inZOI has built [b]modding using Unreal Blueprints[/b] (changed from the previous Lua iteration).
🔹 The inZOI team will provide [b]modding guides and tools[/b] for easier implementation.


[b]Will we get more diverse hairstyles?[/b]
✅ [b]Yes![/b] Many new [b]curly, coiled, and Black hairstyles[/b] have been added after your feedback.
🔹 These styles take [b]up to 3x longer to develop[/b] than straight hair due to [b]complex textures[/b] and will require a higher data load in actual use.


[b]Are tattoos included in the game?[/b]
✅ Yes, but limited at EA launch.
🔹 Facial and neck tattoos available initially.
🔹 [b]Full-body tattoos[/b] expected [b]around August 2025.[/b]
🔹 AI-generated tattoos will later allow[b] custom designs.[/b]


[b]🏙️ World & Building Mechanics[/b]

[b]Can we build an entire city from scratch?[/b]
[b]❌ No, [/b]due to the[b] massive computational load.[/b]
✅[b] However, the city is highly customizable,[/b] allowing you to modify many of its roads and public areas to make it feel unique.
 

[b]Will Smart Zois technology apply to animals?[/b]
🔹 The team [b]wants [/b]to extend the Smart Zois system to[b] animals and other living things,[/b] but [b]it's not a priority until the human Zoi version has fully matured.[/b]

 
[b]How realistic are driving mechanics?[/b]
[b]❌ Not as advanced as other driving-centric games.[/b]
🔹 Driving[b] isn't a primary gameplay focus[/b], and [b]car customization[/b] will be prioritized over [b]driving physics[/b]. However, there may be improvements in the future where the driving feels “better” in certain circumstances.
 

[b]Will swimming pools & swimming be in the game?[/b]
[b]❌ Not at EA launch.[/b]
🔹 The team [b]worked on swimming but wasn’t satisfied with the quality,[/b] so it will be [b]added later after improvements.[/b]


[b]Will hospitals be in the game?[/b]
[b]❌ Not at EA launch.[/b]
🔹 Creating an[b] immersive hospital experience[/b] (with diagnostics, treatments, and doctor-patient interactions) is a[b] big project[/b] that will come later.


[b]🎮 Platforms & Performance[/b]

[b]Will inZOI have controller support?[/b]
[b]❌ Not at EA launch[/b] but [b]will be added sometime after release.[/b]


[b]Is inZOI compatible with Steam Deck?[/b]
[b]✅ Yes,[/b] but it has [b]not been officially optimized with Valve.[/b]
🔹 The game [b]runs fine,[/b] but you[b] may need to adjust settings.[/b]


[b]🔥 Miscellaneous & Fun Questions[/b]

[b]Will Zois be able to… have interactions that allow them to create a baby?[/b] (intentionally extended interpretation for our intended audience)
[b]✔️ Sort of![/b]
🔹 The[b] "interaction" is implied but not explicitly shown[/b] (due to age ratings).
🔹 You[b] will need to use your imagination.[/b]


[b]Can Zois commit murder?[/b]
[b]❌ No.[/b]
✅ A completely off-topic but perhaps useful information is that you [b]can start a house fire[/b], and if a certain Zoi[b] just happens to be in that house, they will unfortunately die.[/b]
🔹 Members of KRAFTON and inZOI Studio [b]do not condone[/b] this behavior in real life.


[b]Why do Zois wear towels in the shower?[/b]
[b]🔹 Due to the game’s ultra-realistic graphics[/b], using pixelated censorship [b]looked overly suggestive[/b]. (They actually tested this ourselves during development, so you can trust us on this 😓)
🔹 The team [b]is open to Creators' suggestions[/b] for better solutions.


[b]🎉 Closing Remarks[/b]
🔹 The inZOI team [b]deeply appreciates the community’s support[/b] and is excited for inZOI’s Early Access launch!
🔹 The [b]Online Showcase (happening on March 19, 2025)[/b] will reveal more details about the game.
[b]🔹 Early Access Release Date: March 28, 2025 🚀[/b]



We promise to continue engaging and improving, and once again, we deeply appreciate your support and interest!
